newsitem.title: UK: Pair of Chippendale armchairs fetch $2.8 million.
newsitem.headline: Pair of Chippendale armchairs fetch $2.8 million.

text.p: An anonymous buyer paid a record $2.8 million at auction on Thursday for a pair of giltwood armchairs made by Thomas Chippendale.
"The pair are the world's most expensive English armchairs," a spokeswoman for Christie's auction house said.

Chippendale made the armchairs, which were part of a suite commissioned by Sir Lawrence Dundas in the 1760s. Robert Adam designed the suite for a house in London where they remained until it was demolished in 1934.
Christie's said the suite is one of the earliest examples of Chippendale working in the neo-classical style.
